figures.name: Tabiti

ability.name: Sacred Hearth
ability.description: All Scythian cards are sustained; they cannot be starved of resources for 3 turns.

figures.description: The supreme goddess of the Scythians, queen of the gods and goddess of the sacred fire, invoked first in all oaths and rituals.

figures.name: Papaeus

ability.name: Sky Father's Oath
ability.description: Seal an unbreakable oath; one enemy card must keep its current action for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Scythian name for the sky father, their supreme male deity corresponding to Zeus, husband of Api the earth goddess.

figures.name: Api

ability.name: Earth Mother
ability.description: Draw power from the earth; all earth-domain allies gain 3 HP and +2 defense.

figures.description: The Scythian earth goddess with serpent legs, the great mother deity who was wife of Papaeus the sky god.

figures.name: Targitaus

ability.name: Golden Gifts
ability.description: Present the three golden gifts; choose one: +3 power, +3 defense, or +3 magic for all allies.

figures.description: The legendary first human and ancestor of the Scythians, whose three sons competed to receive the fallen golden gifts that established the three Scythian tribes.

figures.name: Kolaxais

ability.name: Chosen Heir
ability.description: Only those worthy may claim this; gain +4 to all stats if your stats are highest.

figures.description: The youngest son of Targitaus who successfully received the golden gifts, becoming the founder of the royal Scythian tribe.

figures.name: Oetosuros

ability.name: Sun Wind Healing
ability.description: Heal all allied cards for 5 HP; the sun-wind drives away all illness.

figures.description: The Scythian deity corresponding to Apollo, god of the wind and healing, whose worship involved sacred horses.

figures.name: Artimpasa

ability.name: Moon Divination
ability.description: Look at the top 5 cards; rearrange them and place 2 in your hand.

figures.description: The Scythian version of Aphrodite, goddess of love and the moon, associated with the sacred Enarei diviners who served her.

figures.name: Thamimasadas

ability.name: Horse and Sea
ability.description: Summon sacred horses; all mounted allied cards gain +3 speed and +2 power.

figures.description: The Scythian sea god corresponding to Poseidon, whose cult involved the sacred horses of the steppe.

figures.name: Golden Warrior

ability.name: Gold Burial
ability.description: Bury power in gold; preserve one card's stats even after death for future resurrection.

figures.description: The archetypal golden-armored Scythian warrior buried in the great kurgans with treasure, representing the warrior aristocracy's belief in eternal glory.

figures.name: Enarei

ability.name: Androgynous Vision
ability.description: See beyond all boundaries of gender and opposition; predict the next 3 enemy moves.

figures.description: The sacred Scythian shamans transformed by Aphrodite, gifted with divination powers, who served as prophets and intermediaries between worlds.

figures.name: Scythian Amazon

ability.name: Amazon Charge
ability.description: Charge with a warband of warrior women; deal 7 damage to all enemies in one column.

figures.description: The fierce female warriors of Scythian culture, from whom the Greek Amazon myths likely derive, skilled in horse archery and battle.

figures.name: Skolotos

ability.name: Kurgan Legacy
ability.description: Draw power from ancestors in the kurgans; gain +2 to all stats for each dead allied card.

figures.description: The Scythian royal ancestor whose descendants built the great burial mounds of the steppe, connecting the living and dead in an unbroken chain.

figures.name: Sacred Stag

ability.name: Solar Sprint
ability.description: Move to any position at triple speed; cannot be intercepted this turn.

figures.description: The sacred golden stag of Scythian art, an animal of solar significance that appears on the most prized Scythian gold artifacts.

figures.name: Gryphon (Scythian)

ability.name: Gold Mountain Guard
ability.description: Guard the mountain gold; any enemy attempting to steal resources takes 9 damage.

figures.description: The gryphon of Scythian art, depicted endlessly guarding gold in the mountains, a symbol of supernatural power protecting wealth.

figures.name: Sauromatian Shamaness

ability.name: Arrow Prophecy
ability.description: Use an arrow for divination; predict and counter one enemy ability perfectly.

figures.description: The female shamans of the Sauromatians, a related Scythian group, who served as military and spiritual leaders.

figures.name: Herakles (Scythian)

ability.name: Scythian Bow Test
ability.description: Draw the divine bow; only the worthy may use it. If successful, gain +4 power.

figures.description: The Greek Herakles reinterpreted in Scythian myth as their ancestor, who fathered the Scythian people with a serpent-legged woman.

figures.name: Black Sea Nymph

ability.name: Mother of Nations
ability.description: Grant three boons; choose three allied cards each to receive +2 to one stat.

figures.description: The serpent-legged daughter of the river Borysthenes who became mother of the Scythian founding heroes in the Greek account.

figures.name: Scythian Archer

ability.name: Parthian Shot
ability.description: Fire backward while retreating; deal 6 damage even while moving away.

figures.description: The archetypal Scythian horse archer, master of the composite bow, whose tactics and equipment influenced armies across Eurasia.

figures.name: Gold Griffin

ability.name: Griffin Strike
ability.description: Dive from the mountains; deal 10 damage to the enemy with the most gold/resources.

figures.description: The great gold-hoarding griffin of Scythian and neighboring traditions, whose fierce protection of mountain gold made it the apex supernatural predator.

figures.name: Arash (Scythian version)

ability.name: World-Spanning Arrow
ability.description: Fire an arrow that establishes a boundary; no enemy may cross the marked line for 3 turns.

figures.description: A legendary archer figure who fires an arrow to establish the boundary of the Scythian lands, sacrificing himself in the supreme act of archery.
